beats.text: Your A.I. agent got it wrong. Why?
It searched the docs, called a tool, and still answered badly. Was it the search, the prompt, or the model?
Fix found: Arise Phoenix. An X-ray for your A.I. app, free to run on your own machine.
Every request becomes a tree of steps: each search, each tool, each model call, with timings and tokens.
Then grade the answers, with another model as the judge or simple code checks, and test a fix before you ship.
The catch: the server is under the Elastic License, so you can't offer it to others as a hosted service.
And login is off until you switch it on.
